_about: OoTR cows -> remake cows, for tools/rando/parity/songs_trade.py. Read from the level files (Banc/*): the remake has 14 cow placements at 8 spots. The generic Animal_Cow (Hyrule Field grotto, Lon Lon Ranch pair, Kakariko, Death Mountain grotto) shares one scene (its ocarina ReplaceEventParam: Animal_Cow_GiveMilk, Cow_GiveMilk, then Animal_Cow_PushToBottleMilk) and declares no per-placement keys. The scene tells them apart with GameSystemActor.EventQueryIsDistanceBetweenActorsClose to a DestinationAnchor (IsAnchorActorB). An actor whose ocarina replace event looks anchors up has them linked from an EventProxyRequestActor that links the actor itself with an EventProxyRequestLink (every vanilla case: the 18 bean soils, whose Field_PlantMagicBeanStormMelody asks for 'Dirt'; Npc_Pierre, whose BlewOcarinaByPlayer asks for 'BonooruCamera'; the actor itself links none). So each generic cow placement gets an anchor of its own ("anchor", a copy of "anchor_source", a DestinationAnchor of the same file) named after its group, and a proxy ("proxy", an EventProxyRequestActor at the cow) linking the cow (EventProxyRequestLink) and that anchor (Reference); the cow links the anchor too (as Npc_Bonooru links its own anchor besides its proxy). Neither half works alone: anchors linked from other actors (the Kakariko bed's requester, gossip stones) and anchors linked from the cow only (no proxy) both just gave milk. The Lon Lon Ranch pair shares one name and two flags in order (the first cow milked there gives the first item). KF's cow has its own scene entry; GV's (child) and GF's (adult) cows share Cow_GiveMilk_gerudo and are told apart by age ("gv": OoTR's GV Cow; "gf": the remake-only GF Cow, see "remake_only"). "probe" (test builds with the test_start probe "cows" only): two more anchors at Impa's child cow, "own" linked from the cow only and "proxy" from its proxy only, which the probe test's branch asks for.

probe._about: test builds only (test_start probes: cows). Flags: GameData bools no game file names (data/eventsetting_unreferenced.json; template rows nothing plays), set by a probe test's start, cleared by its branch. lookup (Impa's child cow, in Cow_GiveMilk after the Roar): which anchor the event finds, own (linked from the cow only) and/or proxy (from its proxy only); kf: Link's house cow's gate skipped; gv: the GV cow's gate skipped (age and flag); gf: the Gerudo Fortress cow (adult, no OoTR location) gives with no flag at all, then gf_flag if any cow's save flag already reads as set.

remake_only: Gerudo Fortress cow (Animal_Cow_GerudoFortress #11341244778524449886, GerudoFortress_Adult_Static at (58.2, 115.0, 56.3), adult): no OoTR location, so it's a remake-only location of its own, GF Cow (data/rando/logic/songs_trade.json new_locations; region Gerudo Fortress past the horseback archery guard: is_adult and Gerudo_Membership_Card and can_play(Eponas_Song)). It shares Cow_GiveMilk_gerudo with the GV cow; the scene tells them apart by age (the GV cow is child-only, the GF cow adult-only), as for the GV cow. Its give flag: data/rando/songs_trade_flags.json (a borrowed pool flag, tools/rando/free_flags.py).
